title: AI Development Engineer
jobDescription: Gurugram | Full-Time About the Role: We are looking for smart, curious freshers to join as AI Development Engineers. You should have strong Python skills and a basic understanding of Generative AI and ML concepts/tools. This role is perfect for someone eager to build a career in AI and work on production-grade applications across industries. Compensation: 8-12 LPA (Fixed) Eligibility Criteria: B.Tech (2025 or 2026 pass-out) in Computer Science, AI, IT or related disciplines. JEE Main Common Rank List (CRL) Rank under 50,000. What You’ll Do: Build and deploy software components for AI products Work with Python, APIs, and modern web frameworks Assist in data processing and model integration tasks Collaborate with senior engineers and founders Learn AI concepts and contribute to production-ready applications What We’re Looking For: Strong programming skills in Python Basic understanding of APIs, databases, and web apps Curiosity to learn AI tools and workflows Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow Strong analytical skills and the ability to tackle complex problems Good communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative environment Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a passionate and driven team on impactful projects. Access to mentorship and professional development to kickstart your career. Hands-on experience with real-world projects in a supportive and collaborative work environment. Exposure to cutting-edge AI and software development technologies.

title: Campus Recruitment Drive 2027
jobDescription: InteligenAI is conducting its 4th Campus Recruitment Drive for students who want to work on cutting-edge AI systems from Day 1. We are a fast-growing AI product studio building enterprise-grade AI solutions across Agentic AI, document intelligence, advanced RAG systems, automation workflows, and production-ready GenAI applications. Unlike traditional internships or training-first programs, this campus hiring initiative is designed for students who want ownership, fast learning, and exposure to meaningful engineering challenges early in their careers. If you enjoy solving hard problems, learning rapidly, and building products that are actually used by enterprises, you will fit right in here. The environment is fast-paced, hands-on, and designed for people who enjoy solving hard problems and growing through real responsibility. Note: This application form is for the graduating batch of engineering colleges applying through their placement cells.
